title: Unit 25 Consolidation: The Fundamental Law and the Constitutional Court, 2010–2026
grammar: Review: attribution, obligation, proportion, certainty and contrast
goal: I can summarise the Fundamental Law, the Constitutional Court's powers and the states of danger between 2010 and 2026, with years and sources.
I can attribute, qualify and contrast views on these events.
I can report the European rule-of-law procedures and the change of government in 2026 with dates.
